response.justification: The candidate is a highly experienced Staff/Senior Software Engineer with deep full-stack expertise, but this is a significant mismatch for a junior/mid-level, entry-level position. His TypeScript/Node/React background covers the required stack, but he lacks explicit PostgreSQL and Nest.js experience, and his seniority level, salary expectations, and career trajectory are likely misaligned with an entry-level IC role requiring high on-site presence.
strengths: Extensive full-stack experience with TypeScript, Node.js, and React across many companies
Strong software craftsmanship background (TDD, CI/CD, clean architecture) aligning with 'interest in clean architecture' requirement
Currently working with AI-agent infrastructure and MCP, aligning with nice-to-have LLM/API integration interest
concerns: Vastly overqualified for a junior/mid-level entry-level position, risking quick disengagement or turnover
No explicit PostgreSQL or Nest.js experience mentioned (mostly MongoDB, GraphQL)
No mention of AWS core services, Kubernetes hands-on depth, or OCR/ML despite senior generalist background
